scopeLabel: Core CdSe/PerCA4 layer-by-layer film preparation, its necessary PerCA4 precursor preparation, and directly linked product evidence. Optical n=1–5 and n=10 thickness are separate source contexts, without physical-batch joins. Upstream cited recipes and performance/control branches remain pending.

availability.morphology_illustration: No measured atomistic or quantitative specimen geometry is reconstructed. Product and figure contexts remain separately identified.

bindings.caption: Modify ITO-glass with the reported 10^-3 M PVBH solution in ethanol. The cited prior procedure is not supplied here: priming time, cleaning, rinsing and drying remain unreported. Flat ITO-glass support and a symbolic solution bath; vessel dimensions and immersion depth are not measured.

bindings.caption: Dip the PVBH-primed ITO into the preformed CdSe nanocrystal dispersion. Exposure is 5 min. No bath temperature, agitation, transfer-rinse or drying step is specified. Symbolic primed ITO-glass in CdSe dispersion; no finite nanocrystal model, packing geometry or quantitative bath level.

bindings.caption: Alternate to the ethanol PerCA4 bath, with 5 min exposure. The layer order follows the multilayer method; no transfer-rinse, drying or reaction temperature is added. Symbolic coated ITO-glass in linker solution; chemical attachment and layer thickness are not drawn as measured geometry.

bindings.caption: Repeat the alternating baths to build the source-defined multilayers. Figure 1 reports n=1–5 optical growth, while the thickness statement concerns n=10. These contexts do not define a shared physical batch or an interpolated thickness law. Conceptual alternating deposition sequence on a flat substrate; no exact layer count, molecular orientation or nanocrystal packing is rendered.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation
